---
title: Cognigy NLU
description: "Learn about the default Cognigy NLU connector and how to customize it."
keywords: ['cognigy nlu', 'cognigy nlu connector', 'native nlu connector']
---

The Cognigy NLU connector is the native NLU connector integrated into the Cognigy platform.
This connector is selected by default in both the Endpoint settings and the Interaction Panel.

To customize its behavior with [NLU transformers](/ai/platform-features/nlu/external/nlu-connectors/nlu-transformers), follow these steps:

1. Go to **Advanced > NLU Connectors**.
2. Click **Create NLU connector** and select the Cognigy NLU connector type.
3. Update the transformer code to suit your needs.
